title: TabFree Tableau intermediate representation (IR)
description: A faithful, JSON-friendly representation of a Tableau workbook (.twb/.twbx) or data source (.tds/.tdsx), produced by the TWB parser (BUILD_PLAN P2.1). Field references and shelves are also parsed into structured form, and filters, sets, sorts and table calculations are typed, so that later stages can work from the IR alone without re-reading the XML. It keeps Tableau's own names and encodings (for example field references such as [federated.x].[sum:Sales:qk]) so that downstream steps can generate semantic models, query manifests and dashboards deterministically. Credentials are never captured.

parameters.description: Columns of Tableau's special "Parameters" data source.

notes.description: Parser diagnostics: unsupported or partially understood constructs.

blendRelationships.description: Custom data blending links (datasource-relationships): primary data source fields mapped to secondary ones.

raw.description: Untranslated attributes kept verbatim from the XML for later stages.

sourceBuild.description: The root element's source-build attribute (the reliable version signal).

version.description: The root element's version attribute (often stale, e.g. 18.1).

tableau.description: Where the file came from on Tableau Server, when known.

tableauVersion.description: Tableau release that wrote the file, from source-build (else version when it is meaningful), e.g. 2024.2.0.

connection.description: A connection element. Passwords and tokens are never captured.

class.description: Tableau connection class, e.g. redshift, athena, sqlserver, excel-direct, textscan, hyper, sqlproxy, federated.

relation.description: Physical layer relation tree (table, join, union, custom SQL, pivot...).

sql.description: Custom SQL text for type = text.

on.description: Join clause, kept as Tableau's expression tree.

clauses.description: Join clause flattened to field comparisons, when it has that shape.

objectGraph.description: Tableau 2020.2+ logical layer (relationships between logical tables).

cardinality.description: From the end points' unique-key settings.

integrity.description: Referential integrity from guaranteed-value: all records match, or some.

ast.description: Parsed formula, filled in by the compiler front end.

usesUserFunctions.description: USERNAME(), ISMEMBEROF() etc.: a row-level security signal.

defaultFormat.description: Default number or date format string (default-format).

param.description: Parameter domain, for columns of the Parameters data source.

sourceField.description: Field the list is populated from when the workbook opens.

defaultValueField.description: Field whose value becomes the current value when the workbook opens.

group.description: A Tableau group (categorical-bin calculation): members mapped to group names.

other.description: Name of the Other group for unlisted members, when enabled.

published.description: For workbooks that use a published data source (sqlproxy).

drillPaths.description: Hierarchies: drill paths from the top level down.

file.description: Path of the .hyper/.tde inside the package.

limit.description: Top N rows or a sample, when the extract is limited.

incrementalKey.description: Column that identifies new rows for incremental refresh.

sets.description: Data source <group> elements: sets (members, condition, top N), combined fields and Tableau's internal action groups.

fieldInstance.description: A field as used on a sheet, e.g. [federated.x].[sum:Sales:qk].

derivation.description: none, sum, avg, cnt, ctd, attr, usr, yr, qr, mn, dy, tmn, tdy, ...

kind.description: qk = quantitative, nk = nominal, ok = ordinal.

code.description: Derivation code from the instance name, e.g. sum.

expr.description: Shelf expression as written in the XML (with / for nest, + for concatenation, * for cross).

hidden.description: Hidden sheets have no view on Tableau Server.

type.description: layout-flow, layout-basic, viz, text, bitmap, web, filter, paramctrl, color, size, shape, map, title, empty, extension, button, ...

x.description: Tableau zone units: 0..100000 across the dashboard.

floating.description: Floats above the tiled layout (a later child of a root layout-basic zone whose first child is the tiled container).

field.description: For filter, parameter and legend zones.

mode.description: Filter control style, e.g. dropdown, checkdropdown, slider.

values.description: Filter control domain: relevant, database, all, context.

sheet.description: Target name that matched no sheet or dashboard.

fields.description: Source to target field mappings (filter link fields, parameter source field).

setMode.description: Set actions: assign, add or remove.

aggregation.description: Parameter actions: aggregation of the source field.

state.description: Sheets whose state the story point captured (capturedDeltas).

table.description: Logical table qualifier, e.g. __tableau_internal_object_id__ for object-model row counts.

field.description: Bracketed column name as data source columns write it, e.g. [Sales].

derivation.description: Derivation code: none, sum, avg, cnt, ctd, attr, usr, yr, qr, mn, tmn, tdy, io, prc95...

derivationName.description: Tableau's derivation attribute value, e.g. Sum, Month-Trunc.

kind.description: qk = quantitative, nk = nominal, ok = ordinal.

index.description: The :N suffix that numbers duplicate pills (dual axes).

tableCalc.description: Quick table calculation prefix, e.g. pcto, diff, rank, cum.

tableCalcType.description: The table-calc type the prefix stands for, e.g. PctTotal.

prefix.description: Any other prefix before the derivation.

parameter.description: True for references into the Parameters data source.

shelfNode.description: Shelf expression tree: / is nest, * is cross, + is concat; leaves are fields.

setFunction.description: A <groupfilter> set function tree, kept faithfully. Member values use Tableau literal syntax ("East", 1, #2024-01-01#, %null%).

function.description: member, union, except, level-members, empty-level, end (top/bottom N), order, filter (condition), range, crossjoin, intersection...

ui.description: Tableau user: namespace UI hints (ui-marker, ui-enumeration, ui-pattern-*...).

countExpression.description: Count when not a literal, e.g. [Parameters].[Top N].

countParameter.description: The parameter reference when the count is a parameter.

tableCalc.description: <table-calc> settings: ordering (compute using), addressing and partitioning, level, restart, rank options and a secondary calc.

field.description: The nested calculated field these settings apply to.

restart.description: level-break: the field at which the calculation restarts.

level.description: level-address: the level the calculation is computed at.

addressing.description: Addressing fields (order elements) when ordering-type is Field; the view's other dimensions partition.

address.description: Relative-to address values, e.g. -1 for the previous member.

secondary.description: Secondary calculation (a second <table-calc> without a field attribute).

nested.description: Settings for table calcs nested in a calculated field, each naming its calc in field.

kind.description: set, combined (combined field / crossjoin) or internal (Tableau's sheet_link/include/exclude helper groups).

members.description: Selected (or, with exclude, removed) members in Tableau literal syntax.

levels.description: Fields combined or filtered when the set is not a simple member list.

hide.description: kind=hide: hides marks without filtering the data.

members.description: Selected (or, with exclude, removed) members in Tableau literal syntax.

levels.description: Fields combined or filtered when the set is not a simple member list.

using.description: Sort-by field reference for computed and shelf sorts.
